reverse_expectations.method: 10-year owner-cash-per-share DCF including annual owner cash and terminal multiple
reverse_expectations.interpretation: At a 10% hurdle and 18x terminal, price requires only about 2.2% annual owner-cash/share growth, implying the market discounts substantial structural deterioration versus historical economics.

permanent_loss_stress.thesis: Domestic franchise erosion, persistent Latin-America credit losses, failed U.S./China scaling and margin compression.

bear.thesis: Global core survives but Medsystems cash conversion remains weak and per-share compounding is only low single digits.

base.thesis: Overseas installed base/consumables compound, Brazil/Japan direct sales normalize, domestic stabilizes and owner cash/share grows high single digits.

bull.thesis: CLASSYS becomes a global multi-modality aesthetic platform with successful U.S./China scaling, cross-selling and direct-market economics.

warning: Scenario values are underwriting ranges, not price targets. Open Hard Veto investigation supersedes attractive valuation.
